# Stable Sato Viewer

**Stable Sato Viewer** is a Windows desktop application for viewing and managing metadata (prompts, negative prompts, generation parameters) from PNG images generated by Stable Diffusion.

![Stable Sato Viewer](PngViewer/Assets/stablesatoviewer.png)

[日本語版 README はこちら](README.md)

## Key Features

- :file_folder: **Folder Tree View** - Browse drives hierarchically and navigate between folders easily
- :framed_picture: **Image Viewer** - Display and zoom PNG images
- :mag_right: **Mouse Scroll Zoom** - Zoom in/out with scroll, drag-to-pan, cursor-centered zoom, window resize support
- :memo: **Metadata Display** - Extract and display information from PNG tEXt/iTXt chunks:
  - Prompt (Parameters)
  - Negative Prompt
  - Generation Parameters (Steps, CFG Scale, Sampler, etc.)
- :mag: **Filter Function** - Search and filter images by prompt content
- :star: **Favorites Management** - Bookmark frequently used images
- :art: **Multiple Layout Modes** - Switch display modes based on your needs
- :clipboard: **Clipboard Copy** - Click cells to copy text to clipboard
- :wastebasket: **Recycle Bin Delete** - Safely delete unwanted images
- :floppy_disk: **State Persistence** - Remember window size, position, and last opened image

## System Requirements

- **OS**: Windows 10/11
- **.NET**: .NET 10.0 Runtime or later
- **Other**: WPF compatible environment

## Installation

### Release Version (Recommended)

1. Download the latest version from [Releases](https://github.com/satochan0112/stable-sato-viewer/releases)
2. Extract the ZIP file
3. Run `StableSatoViewer.exe`

### Build from Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/satochan0112/stable-sato-viewer.git
cd stable-sato-viewer/PngViewer
dotnet build -c Release
```

## Usage

### Zoom Functionality

#### Scroll to Zoom

- **Mouse wheel up**: Zoom in (up to 500%)
- **Mouse wheel down**: Zoom out (minimum size that fits the window)
- Zoom changes are applied gradually

#### Cursor-Centered Zoom

- When scrolling to zoom, the zoom is centered on the mouse cursor position
- Allows intuitive zooming into the area you want to examine

#### Drag to Pan

- When the image is zoomed in, drag to move the visible area
- Useful for examining zoomed-in details

#### Window Resize Support

- When you resize the window, the zoom automatically resets to the minimum value that fits the new window size
- The entire image remains visible even if the window is small

#### Zoom Percentage in Window Title

- Current zoom level is displayed as "Zoom: 100%" in the window title
- Provides a reference for the current zoom level

### Other Basic Features

For detailed usage instructions, see:

- **Opening Images**: Folder tree, drag-and-drop, command-line arguments
- **Metadata Display**: Prompts, negative prompts, generation parameters
- **Favorites**: Bookmark images, delete individual favorites, clear all
- **History**: Manage opened images, reopen from history
- **Filter**: Search images by prompt content

## Keyboard Shortcuts

| Key | Function |
|-----|----------|
| `Left` / `Right` | Previous image / Next image |
| `Delete` | Move image to recycle bin |
| `Esc` | Exit fullscreen mode |

## Configuration Files

Application state is saved in the following directory:

```
%AppData%\StableSatoViewer\
├─ windowstate.json    # Window size, position, layout mode
├─ favorites.json      # Favorites list (JSON format)
├─ history.json        # History (JSON format)
├─ lastfolder.txt      # Last selected folder
└─ lastimage.txt       # Last displayed image
```

## Technology Stack

- **Framework**: .NET 10.0
- **UI**: WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation)
- **Language**: C# 14.0
